description:
Convert selected Chinese text without leaving the Mac app you're writing in. Customizable global shortcuts can convert and replace a selection in an editable field, or open that selection in OpenCCman for review. Compatible apps can also send selected text through macOS Services. Replacement requires Accessibility permission and depends on the source app; protected or read-only fields may not support it.

For longer documents, import or drop a UTF-8 TXT file, compare source and result side by side or stacked, then export the latest successful result. Narrow windows adapt to a stacked layout. Text conversion runs locally on your Mac. Launch at Login is available on macOS 13 or later.

Choose Simplified Chinese, OpenCC Traditional, Taiwan Standard with Taiwan idioms, or Hong Kong Traditional. Advanced character-variant and regional wording controls remain available. Simplified output is not a complete reverse conversion of Taiwan-specific vocabulary.

File handling supports one UTF-8 TXT file up to 10 MiB, with or without a BOM; export uses UTF-8 without a BOM and preserves line endings, blank lines, and Unicode text. Big5 and GBK files must first be saved as UTF-8. Batch files and files over 10 MiB are not supported, including with Pro.

Free users can complete 12 homepage conversions a day, shared across windows; importing, exporting, and changing presets do not count. Lifetime Pro is a one-time purchase that removes this homepage limit and in-app recommendations. Restore purchases from Settings.

OpenCCman converts Chinese characters and regional wording with OpenCC. It does not translate Mandarin and Cantonese, generate pinyin, or offer a Japanese Shinjitai conversion mode. Open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/gewill/OpenCCman
whatsNew:
Four conversion presets and a single UTF-8 TXT import/export workflow, up to 10 MiB.
Switch between side-by-side and stacked panes on Mac and iPad. On iPhone, a compact Convert button leaves more room to read.
Cancel conversion or import without accepting late results. Purchase support is available in Settings.
